2125249325340983345.en_summary: Traditional and onchain finance continue to converge. As tokenization has become increasingly popular in US markets, tokenized stock on Solana can now serve as collateral. For example, owners of Ondo's tokenized Tesla stock, $TSLA, can be utilized as collateral for DeFi lending. This means investors can now obtain liquidity without directly selling exposure to the underlying asset. Meanwhile, institutional activity now includes JP Morgan, BNY Mellon, State Street, and others using Solana-related infrastructure. This shift has driven tokenized equity supply on Solana to over $600 million, up +210% YTD. Jupiter reported 72% QoQ increase in volume in these tokenized assets.
2125249325340983345.zh_summary: 傳統和鏈上金融繼續融合。隨著代幣化在美國市場日益流行，Solana上的代幣化股票現可作為抵押品。例如，Ondo代幣化特斯拉股票$TSLA的擁有者可用作DeFi借貸抵押。這意味著投資者現可獲得流動性而無需直接出售標的資產敞口。同時，機構活動包括摩根大通、紐約梅隆、State Street等使用Solana相關基礎設施。這一轉變使Solana上代幣化股權供應超過6億美元，年內上漲210%。Jupiter報告這些代幣化資產交易量季比增加72%。

2125249061485769094.en_summary: Technical analysis tells me to not buy stocks under the 20, 50 and 200 day moving averages because the odds of the price moving up over the next short to intermediate term is (very) low. It's wild how many TA haters came out. TRADING does not care about which stock is moving - only that it is and TRADERS can profit. $NVDA may double its market cap over the next 2 years while some shit stock quadruples in 2 weeks. As a TRADER, which should you be looking to TRADE? BTW trends are down for now. Not the time to play hero ball.. TRADERS.
2125249061485769094.zh_summary: 技術分析告訴我不要買低於20、50和200日均線的股票，因為短期到中期價格上漲的機率（非常）低。很多TA反對者出現。交易不在乎哪隻股票在動 - 只在乎它在動且交易者能從中獲利。$NVDA未來2年市值可能翻倍，而某些垃圾股2週內市值翻4倍。作為交易者，你應該交易哪個？順便說，趨勢現在是向下的。不是玩英雄球的時候..交易者。
